result.reason: The file conforms to every Service Convention criterion. Structure: it exports a single entry point `run(store, input)` with the Store first and a single input object, returning `Result<Review>` from domain types; the module name `create-review.ts` is verb-first kebab-case. Behavior: all domain failures are returned as `{ ok: false, error }` values with no throws; every error message names what was wrong and what would be accepted; all validation occurs top-to-bottom before any store work; the service does one thing; and the only I/O is through the injected Store. Documentation: the doc comment states the purpose in one sentence and enumerates all four failure modes (unknown parlor id, invalid rating, empty author, short tasting notes), matching the errors returned in the body.

The file satisfies all criteria defined in the specification: it exports a single `run` function with correct signature, follows verb-first kebab-case naming, implements domain failures as values with consumer-friendly error messages, validates input before work, does one thing, uses only injected Store for I/O, and includes complete documentation with purpose statement and enumerated failure modes.
